entities.name: Maria Luís Albuquerque
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Maria Luís Casanova Morgado Dias de Albuquerque is a Portuguese politician who is the European Commissioner for Financial Services and the Savings and Investments Union under the Second Von der Leyen Commission. She served as Minister of State and Finance between 2013 and 2015.
